about.heading: More than writing code, I design systems.
about.body: I'm a systems engineer and software developer. I'm interested in building solutions that combine development, automation and artificial intelligence to solve real problems in a clear, maintainable and efficient way. I keep learning constantly — new tools, new languages, new ways to solve the same problem better.
